translations.web: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
translations.bsb: and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’
translations.kjv: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
